title: U.S. GoldMining Inc. 8-K Filing — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement and Other Events
summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its Warrant Agency Agreement with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, allowing the company to extend warrant duration at its discretion. The board subsequently approved extending the termination date of the warrants from April 24, 2026 to May 1, 2026. The warrants (USGOW) remain listed on Nasdaq Capital Market.
key_points: U.S. GoldMining Inc. entered into an amendment to the Warrant Agency Agreement on April 23, 2026
The amendment permits the company to extend warrant duration by delaying the Termination Date
Board approved warrant extension from April 24, 2026 to May 1, 2026
Warrants (USGOW) trade on Nasdaq Capital Market and are exercisable at $13.00 per share
Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company remains as warrant agent
